purpose: Parallel recovery of important Prometeo work that may still depend too heavily on historical chats. Each worker routes to existing authority first, persists durable recovery/state, and publishes only authorized cross-workstream deltas.
closure_semantics: The Recovery Sweep is closed when every R01-R10 lane has a durable return or is explicitly absorbed by a current owner, all recovery-only workers are no longer falsely active, every observed residual branch is either integrated or deliberately retained by policy, authority pointers remain unchanged unless separately authorized, and the post-commit Agent Runtime successfully recompiles this main head.

lanes.scope: PROMETEO LAB R1-A — research, checkpoints, experiments, artifacts and decisions
lanes.goal: Recover durable findings; distinguish adopted vs evidence-only vs unresolved; reconcile with later authority without replaying R1-A.

lanes.scope: PROMETEO LAB R1-B — architecture, engines, persistence, Context Foundry, release/rollback and QA
lanes.goal: Determine what later Prometeo actually adopted and preserve current technical invariants without creating a second architecture.

lanes.scope: PROMETEO LAB R1-C / AMP-1 / AMP-2 — contrast, falsification and negative knowledge
lanes.goal: Preserve alternatives rejected, attacks, contradictions and repairs so later workers do not repeat failed approaches.

lanes.scope: Spatial Navigator — V50/V53, Exact Back and human-accepted physics
lanes.goal: Recover lineage and regression matrix; preserve navigation physics and version-specific capabilities without redesigning accepted behavior.

lanes.goal: Recover accepted tactile specimens, bicolor rules, physical control language, sound/input rules and negative visual knowledge.
Recover schemas, theory-practice-map architecture, hints/traps/feedback, import formats, pedagogical invariants and strongest material demos.
Recover capability lineage across versions, including laser, whiteboard, Wacom, curves, eraser, tabs and fullscreen; detect regressions without collapsing distinct owners.
Recover low-maintenance product philosophy, interaction model, latest demo, bugs/rejections and public product rules without publishing private personal data.

post_commit_runtime_assertion.condition: The published gh-pages agent-runtime/manifest.json main_head MUST equal the repository main commit containing this FINAL_CLOSED sweep record, the Prometeo Agent Runtime v3 workflow for that head MUST succeed, and the compiled runtime MUST expose R04/R06/R07 as closed recovery while preserving R10 as its active product-owner frontier rather than a recovery lane.
post_commit_runtime_assertion.reason: Embedding the future runtime epoch inside the same main commit would create a self-referential recompilation loop; the integrator verifies the published EPOCH/runtime externally after this final write.

integration_rule: Recovery is consumed from durable artifacts, canonical workstream returns and the compiled Agent Runtime. Historical chats are not required for continuation. Product promotion remains a separate explicit authority process.
